Board 04 — number colours against the three accents owner request, 2026-11-02

The owner's complaint: with the teal accent the unsigned figures are teal (#0f766e) and the gains another green (#047857), two greens on one card; with coral, a coral total beside a red loss (#b91c1c). Today's rule (DESIGN.md, stat-card value-color): a KPI value takes the active accent, except signed money, which takes --color-positive/--color-danger.

Q7 — C: the accent is for controls only. Unsigned figures take --color-text; a signed figure takes gain = brand teal, loss = brand coral, whatever the accent; --color-positive and --color-danger become aliases of those, so the app has one green and one red. A comment „Q7 A“ or „Q7 B“ flips it.

dashed = new or changed · amber edge = a synthetic row written into the shipped markup of a real one (the seed has no such row) · 1 ties a change to its section's text. Synthetic data only.

Heute — die Regel, wie sie gebaut ist Vermögen → Bestände (Kennzahlen, Positionen mit G&V) · Übersicht → Kennzahlen-Leiste

Captured as shipped on the review seed (positions cut to two gains and two losses, the value columns switched on in the browser's column preference). The Overview's strip already shows unsigned figures in --color-text, against DESIGN.md's rule; Wealth's cards follow the rule (.stat strong takes the accent).

Variante A — Gewinn immer Teal, Verlust immer Koralle

Owner option 1. Signed figures take brand teal and brand coral whatever the accent; unsigned KPI values keep the active accent. Under the teal accent the total is teal and the gain is teal: the two greens become one, but then a total reads as a gain. Under coral the total reads as a loss. Under violet it works.

Variante B — jede Zahl im Akzent

Owner option 2. No gain/loss colour: every figure in the active accent, the sign carried by its +/− glyph alone. One colour on the card, but a loss of -975,15 reads in the same colour as a gain, and under coral every gain is red-ish; the colour no longer helps the scan the table exists for.

Variante C (empfohlen) — der Akzent nur für Bedienelemente Vermögen → Bestände

Unsigned figures in --color-text, a gain in brand teal, a loss in brand coral, under every accent. Where C still collides, honestly: under the teal accent the active tab, links and buttons are teal beside teal gains, and under coral they are coral beside coral losses. The collision moves from figure-against-figure to control-against-figure: a control is told apart by its shape (underline, button frame, link underline), and no figure is accent-coloured any more.

The sign is never colour alone. Every signed figure on these frames carries its glyph: „+9,0%“, „+7.348,65“, „+75,00“, „-975,15“ (the cards' sub-line too); B leans on that alone, A and C add colour on top. An unsigned figure has no colour to read under C, so it cannot be mistaken for a gain.

Q7, recommended C. (1) One green, one red: the two greens and the two reds disappear under every accent, which A achieves only for signed figures and B by dropping colour from the sign. (2) The accent keeps one job, „you can act here“, so a teal total no longer reads like a teal gain or a teal link. (3) The brand colours carry the meaning and already pass 4.5:1 on every surface (table above, and the invariant test pins them for the accent use). (4) The strip already does it: the Overview's KPI strip shows unsigned figures in the text colour today. Cost: C recolours every consumer of --color-positive/--color-danger (README lists them), and DESIGN.md's stat-card rule changes.
